interface.signature: nthCharacter(S: str, R: int, N: int) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all(c in '01' for c in S)

preconditions.description: R is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and 0 <= N < len(S) * (2 ** R)
preconditions.description: N is an integer within the valid range for the final string length.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a single binary character.
The returned value is the Nth character of the string after R iterations.
